newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh minister sacked for clearing slum.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh minister sacked for clearing slum.

text.p: Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has sacked Housing and Public Works State Minister Afsaruddin Ahmed Khan after he evicted thousands of slum dwellers near Dhaka, the Official BSS news agency said.
The agency, quoting sources at the prime minister's office, said late on Monday the minister had not given the dwellers at Vasantek slum enough warning before evicting them.
Officials at the prime minister's office said Hasina was shocked by the plight of nearly 20,000 poor people after their shanties were razed by 10 bulldozers.
The sacking was Hasina's first major disciplinary action against a minister since taking office last year.
"The prime minister has given assurances that the slum dwellers will be rehoused," BSS said.
